proposal:
SELECT 
    rd.botdetreg AS robot_id, 
    mf.faultpredscore AS predicted_failure_risk, 
    mf.rulhours AS minimum_remaining_useful_life, 
    op.totopshrval AS TOH, 
    op.progcyclecount AS number_of_operations, 
    mf.issuelevelval AS maintenance_priority_level
FROM 
    robot_details AS rd
JOIN 
    maintenance_and_fault AS mf ON rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
JOIN 
    operation AS op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
ORDER BY 
    mf.faultpredscore DESC, mf.rulhours ASC;
